tool.name: pmotools export_pmo_into_xlsx
tool.description: Export all PMO sections into an Excel workbook
tool.help:
@HELP_PREAMBLE@
**Export PMO to XLSX**
Exports all sections of a PMO file into a multi-sheet Excel (.xlsx) workbook. Each PMO section (specimen_info, sequencing_info, target_info, panel_info, microhaplotypes_detected, etc.) is written to a separate worksheet.
**Input**
- A PMO JSON file (optionally gzipped)
**Output**
- An Excel (.xlsx) workbook containing all PMO sections
